Simulation domain: horizontal pipe, axis along x, diameter 0.1 m, length 1.0 m. Structured hex mesh of approximately 100 (axial) x 20 (circumferential) x 20 (radial) cells.
Solver: twoPhaseEulerFoam, steady-state, incompressible.
Phases: water (primary) and oil (secondary). Properties: water rho=998, nu=1e-6; oil rho=850, nu=1e-4. Standard mineral-oil demo values.
Turbulence: k-epsilon model for both phases (mixture Re ~ 1e5, fully turbulent). Interfacial drag: Schiller-Naumann model. Gravity vector (0 0 -9.81) acting perpendicular to pipe axis.
Inlet boundary (x=0): U = uniform (1 0 0) m/s (mixture velocity, 1 m/s along x). alpha.water = fixedValue uniform 0.3. k and epsilon fixedValue consistent with 10% turbulence intensity and hydraulic diameter 0.1 m.
Outlet boundary (x=1.0): U = zeroGradient. alpha.water = zeroGradient (NOT fixedValue; this is the critical requirement overriding the original draft). p = fixedValue uniform 0. k and epsilon zeroGradient.
Wall boundary (pipe circumference): U = noSlip. alpha.water = zeroGradient. k and epsilon = zeroGradient. Wall function: standard.
alpha.water field: bounded 0 to 1. Initial field: uniform 0.3 everywhere in the domain.
Initial U field: uniform (1 0 0) m/s.
Write final fields to time directory for post-processing. No other outputs required.
